sample_1.prompt: A fluffy orange cat sitting on a kitchen floor looking deeply embarrassed and sheepish, surrounded by a knocked-over vase and scattered flowers. The cat has one paw raised awkwardly and refuses to make eye contact. Several people in the background are stifling laughter. Warm home interior, bright lighting, humorous and charming atmosphere, photorealistic style with a slightly comedic tone.

sample_2.prompt: A teenage boy standing at the front of a classroom, hand over his mouth in pure horror, having just called his stern-faced teacher 'Mom' by mistake. The teacher raises one eyebrow. The entire class is in various states of trying not to laugh — some hiding behind books, some covering their mouths. The boy's face is bright red. Bright classroom setting, comedic and lighthearted atmosphere, photorealistic style.

sample_3.prompt: A young woman sitting in a corporate video conference meeting, eyes wide open in sudden horror, realizing she has been belting out a pop song at full volume with noise-canceling headphones on while her colleagues on the screen stare at her in disbelief. Her mouth is wide open mid-song. Laptop screen shows a grid of shocked colleagues. Modern home office, comedic and vivid atmosphere, photorealistic style.
